data.exact_reserve_text: The current year claims incurred of GBP 39.4m has largely been driven by adverse experience of casualty business. Although lower than the GBP 66.5m in the prior year, it is prior year deterioration rather than related to deals undertaken in the year.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance-to-close transaction (2017 YOA reinsured into 2022 YOA on 1 July 2023) affecting the run-off and secured reinsurance balances for those years.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 opened 2023 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 489.6m. Using the reported gross claims development triangle (excluding the two most recent underwriting years), cumulative prior-year development shows a net adverse movement (strengthening) of approximately GBP 14.2m (2.9% of opening reserves). Management attribute the adverse movement primarily to deterioration in casualty exposures and inflationary pressures in longer-tail classes; reinsurance arrangements (including funds-withheld support) are relevant to recoverability. The movement was calculated from the gross claims development table in the technical reserves note; RITC activity during the year may distort comparisons and is noted as a data caveat.
raw_causal_phrases: impact of inflation especially in longer tail classes
reinsurance with highly rated or reputable reinsurers
development and potential inadequacy of claims reserves

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure was not provided as a single gross movement in a dedicated 'movement in prior year provision' note. The gross PYD was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Note 3). The report also records reinsurance-to-close activity (2017 into 2022) and use of funds-withheld arrangements (Gibson Re WQS) which can distort development measures; 2021 underwriting year is not presented (syndicate did not participate) which affects the set of 'two most recent' years excluded in the triangle method. Use caution interpreting LOB attribution (only casualty explicitly referenced as driver).
